frame.axes: X east Y north Z up, provisional m

method.fixed_constraints: 6760 slope-matched road samples; 478 apron boundary points z=2 excluding distance <=.75m from road; 281 village boundary interpolated samples x -150..-80 at y=-125; 162 schematic coastal samples z=0 excluding <=6m from apron
method.base: plateau(x,y)*smooth(distance_to_shore/65); blend to apron z=2 within 12m and reconstructed village south edge within 20m. Artificial baseline only.
method.bounds: For each grid point lower=max(z_i-.5*d_i), upper=min(z_i+.5*d_i). Clamp baseline to compatible bounds; exclude road, apron, water and existing village.
method.correction: 8-neighbor min-envelope relaxation with .5 slope limit, then restore independently compatible lower bound. Stop on max change <1e-10 or 100 iterations; assert retained interval.
method.protected: No input file writes; no native model edits.

attempts.cause: artificial baseline local gradient above envelope limit despite pointwise constraints

execution: Actual local Python NumPy 2.3.5, trimesh 4.11.1, Shapely 2.1.2 and SciPy; V10/V11 calculated, source SHA verified before/after, V11 PNG inspected. No Blender or Actions.

outputs.delivery: local attachment only; exact script and NPZ bytes not committed

limitations: No original harbor terrain: cut/fill differences are against invented baseline, not actual earthworks.
Grid excludes road, apron and existing village. No conforming seam, return walls, drainage, foundation or native mesh.
Road/apron overlap is diagnostic; >5mm height difference remains HOLD.
1V:2H is a provisional visual slope target, not geotechnical design. D4 not run. No adoption or main merge.
next: Resolve apron overlap via a single explicit transition surface, not overlay; independent D4 for affected terrain before native precision production. Preserve V09 road and recovered source. Assess significant assumed cutting (~7m max) as an art/design concern rather than accepted ground.
